/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import os

baseline = pathlib.Path('/testbed/.git/qh-tmp/skip-baseline-source')
shutil.copytree('/testbed/src', baseline / 'src')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/_pytest/skipping.py'])
(baseline / 'src/_pytest/skipping.py').write_bytes(original)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PYTHONPATH'] = str(baseline / 'src')
result = subprocess.run([
    'python', '-m', 'pytest', 'testing/test_runner.py',
    '-k', 'test_logstart_logfinish_hooks or test_collect_result or test_current_test_env_var',
    '--basetemp=.git/qh-tmp/skip-baseline-run', '-q',
], env=env)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
PY"
